source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the nuclear reactor (PDF 143-145).

blocks.text: Nuclear bijli ghar mein reactor wahi kaam karta hai jo thermal bijli ghar mein bhatti (furnace): bhatti mein koyla ya tel jala kar hararat banti hai, jab ke reactor mein fission hararat banata hai. Uranium (ya doosre bhari) nucleus ka fission taqreeban 200 MeV chhorta hai, jo fission ke tukron ki kinetic energy ki shakal mein aati hai. Yeh tez tukre aapas mein aur uranium atoms se takrate hain, aur un ki kinetic energy hararat ban jati hai. Hararat bhaap banati hai, jo turbine ghumati hai, jo bijli banane wala generator ghumata hai (Fig 19.5).

blocks.alt: Concrete ki dhaal ke andar: steel ka pressure vessel jis mein surkh fuel elements, siyah control rods aur bohat pressure wala pani hai. Garam pani vessel ke oopar daen se pressurizer ke paas se heat exchanger jata, us ke pech-dar pipe se neeche aata aur pump se wapas vessel mein jata hai (sabz teer). Heat exchanger se do pipe dhaal se bahar jate hain: oopar wala bahar (surkh teer), neeche wala andar (neela teer).
blocks.caption: Figure 19.5: nuclear bijli ghar (kitab ki Figure 19.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Reactor ka garam pani (bohat zyada pressure par, taake ubal na sake) oopar wale pipe se heat exchanger jata, wahan doosre pipe ke pani ko bhaap banata aur pump se wapas reactor mein aata hai (sabz teer). Daen taraf surkh teer bhaap ko turbine ki taraf le jata aur neela teer thanda pani wapas lata hai; turbine aur generator is shakal se bahar hain. Pressurizer pressure barqarar rakhta hai. Kitab 'Pressurize' likhti hai; sahi lafz 'Pressurizer' hai.

items: Core: reactor ka sab se ahem hissa, jahan eendhan (fuel) cylinder-numa salakhon ki shakal mein rakha jata hai. Shuru ke reactors qudrati uranium use karte the; jadeed eendhan mein uranium-235 ka hissa taqreeban 2.4 se 3.0 feesad tak barhaya (enrich) jata hai, kyunke qudrati uranium mein yeh sirf 0.7 feesad hai. Plutonium-239 aur uranium-233 bhi eendhan ke taur par use hote hain.

Moderator: eendhan ki salakhein pani ya bhari pani (aam hydrogen ki jagah deuterium, 2-1-H, se bana) jaise kam atomic kamiyat ke maddah mein hoti hain. Is ka kaam fission se nikalne wale tez, tawanai wale neutrons ko dheema karna hai, kyunke dheeme neutrons uranium-235 ya plutonium-239 jaise eendhan mein fission karne mein kaheen zyada mo'assar hain.

Control rods: cadmium ya boron ki salakhein, jo dheeme (slow) neutrons jazb karti hain, core mein andar ya bahar ki jati hain taake har fission ke tamam neutrons mein se sirf aik agla fission kare; yun chain reaction qaboo mein rehta hai. Hangami halat ya marammat ke liye salakhein poori reactor mein gira di jati hain taake chain reaction ruk kar reactor band ho jaye.

Coolant aur heat exchanger: core ka darja hararat taqreeban 500 C tak barhta hai. Hararat zyada dabao par pani, bhari pani ya kisi aur maya ke zariye heat exchanger tak le jayi jati hai, jahan yeh aam pani ko zyada darja hararat ki bhaap banati hai jo turbine aur generator chalati hai. Turbine se taqreeban 300 C par nikalne wali bhaap ko aam taur par darya ya samandar ke pani se thanda kar ke wapas pani banaya jata hai.
Shielding aur hifazat: poora reactor moti concrete ki dhaal mein band hota hai taake shuaein bahar na niklein.

blocks.title: Control rods neutrons jazb karti hain
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke cadmium aur boron ki salakhein 'tez' neutrons jazb karti hain. Yeh neutrons, zyada tar dheeme (thermal), jazb karti hain, jo eendhan mein fission jari rakhte hain; isi tarah yeh chain reaction qaboo karti hain.

blocks.alt: Neutron (1-0-n) jama 238-92-U se 239-92-U jama gamma banta hai. 23.5 minute baad 239-92-U, 239-93-Np jama electron (0-(-1)-e) jama gamma banta hai. 2.4 din baad 239-93-Np, 239-94-Pu jama electron jama gamma banta hai.
blocks.caption: Kya aap jante hain? box: induced nuclear reaction jis mein 238-92-U transuranium element plutonium 239-94-Pu mein badal jata hai (kitab ke box ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: U-238 aik neutron jazb kar ke U-239 banta hai. Phir do beta decay hote hain: har aik mein aik electron (0-(-1)-e) nikalta hai, is liye Z 92 se 93 (Np) aur phir 94 (Pu) ho jata hai jab ke A 239 hi rehta hai. Kitab ki ibarat 'transmitted' likhti hai; sahi lafz 'transmuted' (aik element ka doosre mein badalna) hai.

Karachi nuclear bijli ghar (KANUPP) mein bhari pani moderator aur core se heat exchanger tak hararat le jane dono ke liye use hota hai, jab ke samandar ka pani turbine ki bhaap thanda karta hai. Kitab ke mutabiq Karachi mein teen aur Chashma (Mianwali) mein chaar nuclear bijli ghar chal rahe hain, jin ki kul gunjaish 3000 MW se zyada hai, sab pressurised water reactors jo qareebi darya Sindh (Indus) ke pani se thande hote hain.

blocks.title: Bijli gharon ki tafseel jaanchein
blocks.text: Pakistan ke bijli gharon ke bare mein kitab ke bayanat jazwi taur par mutazad hain: yeh kehti hai ke sab darya Sindh se thande hote hain, lekin Karachi ke plants samandar ka pani use karte hain (jaisa kitab khud KANUPP ke liye kehti hai). Asal KANUPP-1 bhari pani ka reactor tha, pressurised halke pani ka nahi. Yeh tafseelat kitab ke mutabiq di gayi hain aur jaanch ke liye nishan zada hain.

Reactor mein dala nuclear eendhan use chand mahine chalata hai; phir fissile maddah kam hone lagta, istemal shuda eendhan nikal kar taza eendhan dala jata hai. Istemal shuda eendhan mein ab bhi shadeed radioactive maddey hote hain jin ki half-lives hazaron saal hain, aur jin ki shuaein jandaron ke liye bohat nuqsan-deh hain. Nuclear kachra samandaron mein nahi phenka ja sakta na aisi jagah chhora ja sakta hai jahan mitti, hawa ya peene ka pani aaloodah kare. Ise rakhne ki ab tak ki behtareen jagah purani namak ki kaanon ki gehrai hai, jo bohat khushk aur zameen se hazaron metre neeche hain, jahan yeh mahol aaloodah kiye baghair toot sakta hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain? Radioactive kachra
blocks.text: Radioactive kachra teen qism ka hai, high level, medium level aur low level, aur sab zameeni pani aur zameeni mahol ke liye khatarnak hain. Lambi half-lives ki wajah se mehfooz thikana lagana bohat mushkil hai: plutonium ki half-life taqreeban 24,000 saal hai, is liye yeh taqreeban 182,000 saal khatarnak rehta hai. Teen pattiyon wala radiation ka nishan woh jagahein batata hai jahan radioactivity sambhali ya masnoi shuaein paida ki jati hain.

blocks.prompt: Zyada tar reactors mein istemal se pehle uranium eendhan ko enrich kyun karna parta hai?
blocks.explanation: Qudrati uranium mein sirf taqreeban 0.7 feesad fissile uranium-235 hai; chain reaction jari rakhne ke liye bohat kam neutrons agla fission karte (aam pani ke moderator ke saath), is liye uranium-235 ka hissa taqreeban 2.4 se 3 feesad tak barhaya jata hai.

items: Reactor ke hisse: core (eendhan ki salakhein), moderator, control rods, coolant aur heat exchanger, dhaal.
Moderator neutrons dheema karta; control rods jazb karti.
Enriched eendhan (2.4 se 3 feesad U-235); lambi umar ke kachre ko mehfooz zakhira chahiye.
